Maya (Sec): Security bulletin: legacy CI secrets (ssh keys, service account JSONs) found in repo settings and pipeline variables. We're instituting a mandatory remediation: replace with ephemeral credentials (OIDC, Vault-signed certs) within 14 days. Enforcement date: 2026-04-10 00:00 UTC.

sec-bot: Scan 2026-03-24 04:12 UTC -> 46 pipelines across 31 repos with at least one legacy secret. Report: https://go/internal/ci-legacy-secrets-2026-03

Devon (Infra): Is there a canonical migration checklist?

Maya (Sec): Yes 1) inventory secrets per repo, 2) choose method (OIDC for cloud, Vault certs for SSH), 3) use helper tools to create PRs, 4) test on canaries, 5) rotate and remove legacy secret. Migration doc: https://go/internal/ci-secret-migration.

Sam (CI): What helpers exist?

sec-bot: Tools: `tools/migrate_ci_to_oidc.py --repo <org/repo>` and `tools/ssh_secret_rewrite.py --repo <org/repo>`. Both run in dry-run and can open PRs with suggested changes.

Priya (SRE): Enforcement behavior? Failures will look like auth errors in job logs?

Maya (Sec): Correct. Jobs will fail with "access denied" or "key revoked". We'll provide a one-time emergency exception path (max 48h) via https://go/internal/sec-exceptions; approvals: infra-oncall + sec lead.

Devon (Infra): I'll run the tools on the high-risk repos and post PR links.

Sam (CI): Scheduling migration windows for next Tue/Thu; will validate canaries and report back.

Maya (Sec): Please prioritize control-plane and high-deploy services. Post blockers here or DM @sec-oncall. Final reminder: enforcement 2026-04-10 00:00 UTC. Thanks everyone. :lock:
